heading: Read how it was made
first_line: Paint by Moonlight turns a photo into a paint-by-number template on-device; the Marginarium tells how it was made, chapter by chapter.
content_why: Help should be given freely, so the full chapters belong on the page a visitor reaches from the link, not behind a promise.
avoid: Avoid sparkles, wands and showy animation in the README; let the photo-to-template contact sheet carry the magic.
